[B1] < cloudB | 'buffer' : nils , UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestPublish' cloudB | 'toggle'
=> < cloudB | 'buffer' : 'toggle' , UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'acknowledgeReceipt' UserX .
[B2] < cloudB | UserX : ('permission' : OldPermission , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'revokePermission' cloudB | UserX
=> < cloudB | UserX : ('permission' : false , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < cloudB | 'buffer' : Message , deviceB : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestRelease' cloudB
=> < cloudB | 'buffer' : nils , deviceB : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceB | Message if Message =/= nils .
[B3] < deviceB | 'on' : false , ... > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceB | 'toggle'
=> < deviceB | 'on' : true , ... > .
